title: Recording Other Transactions
page_title: Recording Other Transactions | Edexcel IGCSE Accounting Revision Notes 2017

blocks.text: How do I record the purchase of a non-current asset in the ledger accounts?

blocks.md:
- **Debit** the **non-current asset account** in the nominal ledger
- **Credit** the **cash, bank, or a liability account** in the nominal ledger

  - Use the cash or bank account if the business pays upfront
  - Use a liability account if the business buys the asset on credit
  
    - The name will be the name of the lender
- Note that a purchase of a non-current asset is **not entered** into the **purchases account**

  - This is because the purchases account is just for purchases of goods for trading

blocks.text: What other transactions are included in a non-current asset account?

blocks.md:
- The only other transaction that is included in a non-current asset account is its **sale** or **disposal**

  - It will be **credited** with the **original cost** of the non-current asset
  - A **disposal account** will be needed to show the **profit or loss of the sale**
- **Depreciation** will be recorded in a **provision for depreciation account**

blocks.text: How do I record taking out a loan in the ledger accounts?

blocks.md:
- **Debit** the **bank account**

  - The asset is increasing
- **Credit** a **loan account**

  - The liability is increasing

blocks.text: How do I record interest on a loan in the ledger accounts?

blocks.md:
- **Loan interest** is an **expense**
- **Credit** the **bank account**

  - The asset is decreasing
- **Debit** the **loan interest account**
- Do not make any entries for this in the loan account

  - The amount borrowed has **not changed**

blocks.text: What types of income could a business receive?

blocks.md:
- A business will **receive income** from their **sales** of goods or services
- A business can also receive **other income** such as:

  - Rent
  - Commission

blocks.text: How do I record the receipt of an income in the ledger accounts?

blocks.md:
- **Debit** the **cash or bank account**

  - The asset is increasing
- **Credit** the **income account**

blocks.text: What types of expenses could a business pay?

blocks.md:
- The **purchase** of goods is an **expense** to a business
- A business can also incur **other expenses** such as:

  - Rent
  - Commission
  - Rates
  - Wages
  - General expenses
- If a business **receives income** from rent and **also pays** rent then separate accounts are used

  - Rent **payable **is the **expense **account
  - Rent **receivable **is the **income **account

blocks.text: How do I record the payment of an expense in the ledger accounts?

blocks.md:
- **Credit** the **cash or bank account**

  - The asset is decreasing
- **Debit **the **expense account**

blocks.label: Worked Example
blocks.md:
Frank is a sole trader. Frank rents a building for part of his business. Frank also owns a building as part of his business and rents out a room to another sole trader, Karen. - On 1 February 2024, Frank pays \$300 rent by a standing order. - On 3 February 2024, Frank receives \$200 in rent from Karen by bank transfer. Enter these transactions into Frank’s accounts. Answer **Bank Account** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | **Final answer:** **2024**

**Final answer:** **Feb 3** | **Final answer:** **Rent receivable** | **Final answer:** **200** | **Final answer:** **2024**

**Final answer:** **Feb 1** | **Final answer:** **Bank** | **Final answer:** **300** | | | | **Rent Receivable Account** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | | | | **Final answer:** **2024**

blocks.text: How do I record the owner taking drawings in the ledger accounts?

blocks.md:
- The owner could **take assets** from the business for **personal use**:

  - Money
  - Goods
  - Non-current assets
  
    - Such as vehicles
- **Credit** the relevant account

  - **Bank** **account** if money is taken
  - **Purchases account** if goods are taken
  - **Non-current asset account** if a vehicle or machinery is taken
- **Debit** the** drawings account**

blocks.text: How do I record the owner introducing capital in the ledger accounts?

blocks.md:
- The owner might** **put some of their** own money** into the business
- **Debit **the **cash or bank account**

  - The asset is increasing
- **Credit** the **equity account**

blocks.label: Worked Example
blocks.md:
Ahmed is a sole trader. - On 1 January 2024, Ahmed puts \$20 000 into the business bank account from his personal bank account. - On 1 February 2024, Ahmed withdraws \$5 000 from the business bank account for personal use. Record these transactions in ledger accounts for Ahmed’s business. Answer **Bank Account** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | **Final answer:** **2024**

**Final answer:** **Jan 1** | **Final answer:** **Equity** | **Final answer:** **20 000** | **Final answer:** **2024**

**Final answer:** **Feb 1** | **Final answer:** **Drawings** | **Final answer:** **5 000** | **Equity Account** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | | | | **Final answer:** **2024**

**Final answer:** **Jan 1** | **Final answer:** **Bank** | **Final answer:** **20 000** | **Drawings Account** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | **Date** | **Details** | **\$** | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | **Final answer:** **2024**

**Final answer:** **Feb 1** | **Final answer:** **Bank** | **Final answer:** **5 000** | | | |
